kind: bug / Graph / sparse CSR / CPU kernel metadata
title: Graph mode CSRMul fails with dense Tensor operand on CPU
duplicate_search_queries: gh search issues '"Parsed metadata of op[CSRMul] failed" repo:mindspore-ai/mindspore'
duplicate_search_result: No exact matching GitHub or Gitee issue found.
documentation_notes: MindSpore 2.9 local csr_mul docstring accepts x as CSRTensor and y as Tensor, returns CSRTensor, and lists CPU as a supported platform.
MindSpore 2.9 local sparse_func.py implements csr_mul by calling CSRDiv/CSRMul-style CSR kernels and returning CSRTensor(x.indptr, x.indices, res_values, x.shape).
CSRTensor arithmetic is exposed as public API; the operator form x.to_csr() * dense Tensor routes to the same failing CSRMul path.
classification_notes: Not a numerical precision issue: the failing reproducer does not compare floating-point values; Graph mode fails before returning.
Not a CPU unsupported issue: csr_mul docstring lists CPU support, and CSR unary/to_dense controls pass in Graph mode on CPU.
Not an invalid sparse input issue: the same dense-to-CSR input works in PyNative mode and with Graph-mode CSR unary controls.
The Graph error is localized to CSRMul CPU kernel metadata parsing: 'Parsed metadata of op[CSRMul] failed' with an OpIOInfo input-count warning.
